title: LifeVal: Evaluating AI Model Performance on Personalized Agentic Consumer Tasks
title_zh: LifeVal：评估 AI 模型在个性化智能体消费任务上的表现

paragraphs.en: We introduce LifeVal, a benchmark evaluating AI model performance on personalized agentic consumer tasks. LifeVal covers the most valuable life tasks that a personalized digital superassistant could automate, representing over $1.7 trillion USD in annual willingness-to-pay across 148 consumer task categories (e.g., managing finances, moving apartments, searching for a job, finding childcare). To construct our activity distribution, we conducted a new survey of willingness-to-pay for a digital superassistant across a demographically representative sample of over 3,800 consumers, cross-referencing our results against the American Time Use Survey and the Multinational Time Use Study ( Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025 ; Fisher et al., 2025 ) . For the most valuable consumer activities, we recruited task creators to create AI evaluation tasks personalized using real ChatGPT conversations and memories, reference files, and personal context. Task creators had to pass our expertise threshold (including personally completing the task multiple times and seeing the results through in their real lives for over a year) and also write a rubric, ensuring that our evaluation measured the best personalized completion for that task. All tasks had to pass at least three rounds of human quality-control before acceptance into our final evaluation sets.
paragraphs.zh: 我们提出 LifeVal，一个评估 AI 模型在个性化智能体消费任务上表现的基准。 LifeVal 涵盖了个性化数字超级助理能够自动化的最有价值的生活任务，代表横跨 148 个消费任务类别（例如管理财务、搬公寓、找工作、寻找托儿服务）每年超过 1.7 万亿美元的支付意愿。 为了构建我们的活动分布，我们在超过 3,800 名具有人口统计学代表性的消费者中针对数字超级助理的支付意愿开展了一项新调查，并将结果与美国时间使用调查（American Time Use Survey）和跨国时间使用研究（Multinational Time Use Study）进行交叉验证（美国劳工统计局，2025；Fisher 等，2025）。 针对最有价值的消费活动，我们招募任务创建者，利用真实的 ChatGPT 对话和记忆、参考文件以及个人情境来创建个性化的 AI 评估任务。 任务创建者必须通过我们的专业度门槛（包括亲自多次完成该任务，并在现实生活中观察结果超过一年），同时撰写评分细则，以确保我们的评估衡量的是该任务最佳个性化完成方式。 所有任务在被纳入最终评估集之前，必须通过至少三轮人工质量控制。

paragraphs.en: AI models are increasingly acting as digital superassistants: highly capable, personalized agents with deep integration across users’ digital lives. To understand and forecast the impacts of such models, we need to measure their capabilities. One way to measure the consumer capabilities of such models is through usage metrics. However, while usage data tells us about tasks already requested by users, adoption often lags capabilities, and usage metrics don’t capture newer capabilities that take time to adopt, or tasks that users don’t think to ask ( Patwardhan et al., 2025 ) . To better measure the capabilities of AI models in consumer settings, we introduce LifeVal, a benchmark explicitly designed to measure AI capabilities on real-world tasks that consumers deeply value.
paragraphs.zh: AI 模型正日益扮演数字超级助手的角色：它们是能力强大、高度个性化的智能体，并深度融入用户的数字生活。 要理解并预测此类模型的影响，我们需要衡量其能力。 衡量此类模型消费端能力的一种方式是使用使用量指标。 然而，尽管使用数据能反映用户已经提出的任务，但采用往往滞后于能力，使用量指标无法捕捉需要时间才能被采用的新能力，也无法捕捉用户想不到去提出的任务（Patwardhan et al., 2025）。 为了更好地衡量 AI 模型在消费场景中的能力，我们推出了 LifeVal，这是一个明确旨在衡量 AI 在消费者高度重视的真实任务上的能力的基准。

paragraphs.en: LifeVal tasks capture valuable, long-horizon consumer needs:
paragraphs.zh: LifeVal 任务捕捉有价值的、长周期的消费者需求：

paragraphs.en: High Value: LifeVal tasks are pulled from the highest-value tasks from a demographically-representative survey of willingness to pay for AI superassistance, triangulated against the American Time Use Survey and Multinational Time Use Study, which compiles comparable time-use surveys from 25 countries ( Bureau of Labor Statistics, 2025 ; Fisher et al., 2025 ) 1 1 1 Australia, Austria, Belgium, Bulgaria, Canada, the Czech Republic, Denmark, Finland, France, Germany, Hungary, Israel, Italy, the Netherlands, Norway, Peru, Poland, Serbia, Slovenia, South Africa, South Korea, Spain, Sweden, the United Kingdom, and the United States. .
paragraphs.zh: 高价值：LifeVal 的任务取自一项具有人口代表性、关于为 AI 超级辅助付费意愿的调查中价值最高的任务，并与《美国时间使用调查》和《多国时间使用研究》进行交叉验证，后者汇编了来自 25 个国家的可比时间使用调查（美国劳工统计局，2025；Fisher 等，2025）¹¹¹ 澳大利亚、奥地利、比利时、保加利亚、加拿大、捷克共和国、丹麦、芬兰、法国、德国、匈牙利、以色列、意大利、荷兰、挪威、秘鲁、波兰、塞尔维亚、斯洛文尼亚、南非、韩国、西班牙、瑞典、英国和美国。

paragraphs.en: High Context: LifeVal tasks require the model to reference detailed personal data, lengthy ChatGPT conversation histories, and context across different applications.
paragraphs.zh: 高上下文：LifeVal 任务要求模型参考详细的个人数据、冗长的 ChatGPT 对话历史记录，以及跨不同应用程序的上下文。

paragraphs.en: Personalized: LifeVal tasks are highly personalized and subjective, requiring models to adapt to individual preferences.
paragraphs.zh: 个性化：LifeVal 任务高度个性化且主观，要求模型适应个体偏好。

paragraphs.en: Agentic: LifeVal tasks require taking complex actions on a computer, including interacting with websites, accessing account states, filling forms, producing artifacts, and managing digital transactions.
paragraphs.zh: Agentic（智能体化）：LifeVal 的任务需要在计算机上执行复杂操作，包括与网站交互、访问账户状态、填写表单、生成产物以及管理数字交易。

paragraphs.en: Objectively gradable: Despite their subjective nature, LifeVal tasks are possible to objectively grade when conditioned on the provided context.
paragraphs.zh: 可客观评分：尽管 LifeVal 任务具有主观性，但在给定所提供上下文的条件下，仍可对其进行客观评分。

paragraphs.en: LifeVal sits at the intersection of three literatures that have mostly remained separate: agentic benchmarks, personalization and memory benchmarks, and economic literature on task augmentation and automation.
paragraphs.zh: LifeVal 处于三个基本相互独立的文献领域的交汇处：智能体基准、个性化与记忆基准，以及关于任务增强与自动化的经济学文献。

paragraphs.en: AI evaluations are shifting from single-turn academic benchmarks toward interactive, agentic tasks that test whether models can reliably complete real workflows ( Xie et al., 2024 ; Zhou et al., 2024 ) . Performance has risen rapidly since early baselines, including WebArena’s original 14% vs. 78% human gap, OSWorld’s original 12.24% agent performance vs. 72.36% human ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; Xie et al., 2024 ) . More recent verified variants report much stronger results, including 67.3% on WebArena-Verified and 75.0% on OSWorld-Verified for GPT-5.4 ( OpenAI, 2026 ) . This literature suggests several design lessons for LifeVal: (i) partially subjective outcomes are often evaluated with rubrics ( He et al., 2024 ) ; (ii) reinforcement learning environments improve reproducibility relative to the live web ( Zhou et al., 2024 ; XLANG Lab, 2025 ) ; (iii) evaluation harnesses must be hardened against reward hacking ( Wang et al., 2026 ) .
paragraphs.zh: AI 评估正从单轮学术基准转向交互式、智能体式任务，以检验模型能否可靠地完成真实工作流（Xie et al., 2024；Zhou et al., 2024）。 自早期基线以来，性能已迅速提升，包括 WebArena 最初 14% 与人类 78% 的差距，以及 OSWorld 最初 12.24% 的智能体表现与 72.36% 的人类表现（Zhou et al., 2024；Xie et al., 2024）。 更近期的验证版本报告了强得多的结果，包括 GPT-5.4 在 WebArena-Verified 上达到 67.3%，在 OSWorld-Verified 上达到 75.0%（OpenAI, 2026）。 这方面文献为 LifeVal 提供了几条设计经验：（i）部分主观的结果通常用评分细则来评估（He et al., 2024）；（ii）与实时网络相比，强化学习环境提高了可复现性（Zhou et al., 2024；XLANG Lab, 2025）；（iii）评估框架必须经过加固以防范奖励作弊（Wang et al., 2026）。

paragraphs.en: Related work examines how AI systems infer, retain, and apply user preferences ( Li et al., 2025 ) . PrefEval ( Zhao et al., 2025 ) evaluates whether models can remember preferences over long synthetic conversations, while other benchmarks study personalized assistance in conversational and research settings ( Liu et al., 2026 ; Liang et al., 2026 ) . More closely related to LifeVal, PersonalWAB ( Cai et al., 2025 ) combines real shopping histories with generated user profiles to evaluate personalized search and recommendation performance, and Persona2Web ( Kim et al., 2026 ) evaluates whether agents can infer preferences from synthetic user profiles and browsing histories to tasks on the open web. Our work extends personalized agent evaluation by combining real ChatGPT conversation histories and memories with tasks requiring browser and computer use across everyday domains. The same users contribute task-specific rubrics, providing ground truth about whether the agent successfully used their personal context.
paragraphs.zh: 相关工作考察了AI系统如何推断、保留和应用用户偏好（Li et al., 2025）。 PrefEval（Zhao et al., 2025）评估模型能否在长合成对话中记住偏好，而其他基准则研究对话和研究场景中的个性化辅助（Liu et al., 2026；Liang et al., 2026）。 与LifeVal更密切相关的是，PersonalWAB（Cai et al., 2025）将真实购物历史与生成的用户画像相结合，以评估个性化搜索和推荐性能，而Persona2Web（Kim et al., 2026）评估智能体能否从合成用户画像和浏览历史中推断偏好并将其应用于开放网络上的任务。 我们的工作通过将真实的ChatGPT对话历史和记忆与需要浏览器和计算机使用的日常领域任务相结合，扩展了个性化智能体评估。 同一批用户提供针对具体任务的评分标准，为智能体是否成功使用了他们的个人背景提供真实标准。

paragraphs.en: This paper is also closely related to a large literature in economics on task-automating or augmenting technologies ( Autor et al., 2003 ; Acemoglu and Autor, 2011 ; Acemoglu and Restrepo, 2019 ) . When technology sharply reduces the cost of a task, households gain purchasing power, time, or both, and can reallocate those resources toward other goods and services, especially complements to the now-cheaper task ( Greenwood et al., 2005 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 本文也与经济学中关于任务自动化或增强技术的大量文献密切相关（Autor 等，2003；Acemoglu 和 Autor，2011；Acemoglu 和 Restrepo，2019）。 当技术大幅降低某项任务的成本时，家庭将获得购买力、时间，或两者兼有，并可以将这些资源重新配置到其他商品和服务上，尤其是当前变得更便宜的任务的互补品（Greenwood 等，2005）。

paragraphs.en: More broadly, automation can create new consumer demand rather than merely substitute for labor. Agricultural mechanization and productivity growth reduced food prices, allowing households to devote less spending to food and more to manufactured goods and services ( Gollin et al., 2002 ; Herrendorf et al., 2013 ) . Similarly, electrification and labor-saving appliances reduced the time required for cooking, cleaning, and laundry, shifting time out of unpaid home production and into market work and other activities ( Greenwood et al., 2005 ; Ramey, 2009 ) .
paragraphs.zh: 更广泛地说，自动化能够创造新的消费需求，而不仅仅是替代劳动。 农业机械化和生产率的提高降低了食品价格，使家庭能够将更少的支出用于食品，而将更多的支出用于制成品和服务（Gollin et al., 2002；Herrendorf et al., 2013）。 类似地，电气化和节省劳动力的家用电器减少了做饭、清洁和洗衣所需的时间，使时间从无偿的家庭生产转移到市场工作和其他活动（Greenwood et al., 2005；Ramey, 2009）。

paragraphs.en: When the marginal cost of completing a task falls far enough, technology can also expand access. In the U.S., digital retail increased consumer surplus by adding variety and convenience, especially for households outside dense urban markets ( Brynjolfsson et al., 2003 ; Sinai and Waldfogel, 2004 ; Dolfen et al., 2023 ) . Such effects may be larger when a technology lowers the cost of many consumer tasks at once.
paragraphs.zh: 当完成任务的边际成本降得足够低时，技术还能扩大获取渠道。 在美国，数字零售通过增加商品种类和便利性提升了消费者剩余，尤其是对密集城市市场之外的家庭而言（Brynjolfsson 等，2003；Sinai 和 Waldfogel，2004；Dolfen 等，2023）。 当一项技术同时降低许多消费者任务的成本时，这类效应可能更大。

sents.zh: 当一项技术同时降低许多消费者任务的成本时，这类效应可能更大。

paragraphs.en: Many LifeVal tasks — coordinating home services, managing finances, communicating with providers, and navigating taxes — are inputs into household production rather than final consumption. These activities are quantitatively important, as households devote substantial time to home production and to purchasing and coordinating goods and services ( Aguiar and Hurst, 2007 ; Ramey, 2009 ) . Tax filing is one clear example, where many low-income households pay for assistance to access tax-administered benefits, and filing frictions affect claiming behavior ( Bhargava and Manoli, 2015 ) . In most other domains, however, the relevant margin is the cost of administrative burden. Incomplete take-up of social services reflects learning costs, paperwork requirements, and other barriers that deter eligible households ( Currie, 2004 ; Finkelstein and Notowidigdo, 2019 ; Herd and Moynihan, 2019 ) . Reducing the cost of these tasks may therefore generate welfare gains through time savings, lower expenditures, and expanded access for households that would otherwise be unable to participate.
paragraphs.zh: LifeVal 中的许多任务——协调家政服务、管理财务、与服务提供者沟通以及处理税务——是家庭生产的投入，而非最终消费。 这些活动在数量上十分重要，因为家庭在生产性家务以及购买和协调商品与服务上投入了大量时间（Aguiar and Hurst, 2007；Ramey, 2009）。 报税就是一个明显的例子：许多低收入家庭为获得协助以领取由税务部门管理的福利而付费，且申报摩擦会影响领取行为（Bhargava and Manoli, 2015）。 然而，在大多数其他领域中，相关的边际是行政负担的成本。 社会服务领取率不完整，反映了学习成本、文书要求以及其他阻碍符合条件家庭领取的障碍（Currie, 2004；Finkelstein and Notowidigdo, 2019；Herd and Moynihan, 2019）。 因此，降低这些任务的成本，可能通过节省时间、降低支出以及扩大原本无法参与的家庭的可及性，从而带来福利收益。

paragraphs.en: To construct the initial set of tasks for LifeVal, we used data from the American Time Use Survey (ATUS, 2024; n=7,700) and the Multinational Time Use Study (MTUS, 2020; n=8,782). ATUS is a detailed time-use taxonomy created by the U.S. Bureau of Labor Statistics (BLS) that documents how people allocate their time across daily activities. MTUS is a database of international time-use diary surveys, designed to make activity categories comparable across countries. Together, these datasets provide a detailed view of how people spend their time across a full 24-hour period, including differences between weekdays and weekends and across different times of year. We cleaned the data based on the procedure outlined in A.1 .

paragraphs.en: We then estimated the potential value of an AI digital superassistant for each task. We considered whether task categories could simply be weighted by the amount of time people spend on them. But for consumer life tasks, time spent is often a poor proxy for value: some tasks are relatively infrequent or short in duration, yet highly consequential when they arise, such as tax preparation, choosing health insurance, or obtaining preventive health care. Moreover, sometimes life tasks that take a lot of time (e.g., sleeping, eating) can only be moderately impacted by a personal digital superassistant; an AI model can give advice about these activities, but it cannot sleep for you or eat for you. This makes measuring AI impacts on life tasks different from work-related tasks. For work tasks, the value from an AI superassistant can often be approximated more directly using average wages multiplied by hours worked for the relevant occupation.
paragraphs.zh: 然后，我们估算了 AI 数字超级助手在每项任务上的潜在价值。 我们考虑了是否可以简单地按照人们花费在任务类别上的时间来进行加权。 但对于消费者生活任务来说，所花费的时间往往不能很好地代表其价值：有些任务发生频率相对较低或持续时间较短，但一旦出现却影响重大，例如报税准备、选择健康保险或获得预防性医疗保健。 此外，有时那些耗时较多的生活任务（例如睡觉、吃饭）只能被个人数字超级助手适度地影响；AI 模型可以就这些活动提供建议，但它无法替你睡觉或替你吃饭。 这使得衡量 AI 对生活任务的影响不同于对工作任务的影响。 对于工作任务，AI 超级助手带来的价值通常可以用相关职业的平均工资乘以工作时间来更直接地进行近似估算。

paragraphs.en: Because no comparable market wage exists for many personal life tasks, we supplemented the ATUS/MTUS task data with a willingness-to-pay survey (n=3,837), with recruitment targeting US Census distributions for age, gender, and ethnicity from Census Bureau population estimates (2021), and income from the Current Population Survey Annual Social and Economic Supplement (CPS-ASEC, 2025) ( U.S. Census Bureau, 2021 ; U.S. Census Bureau, 2025 ) . We specified a hypothetical perfect digital superassistant that could provide advice and perform digital tasks, but could not perform physical work. Respondents estimated the maximum amount they would have paid over the course of 2025 for digital assistance with each activity (respondents remained responsible for the cost of any goods or services arranged). Each respondent evaluated a randomized subset of 30 activity categories.

paragraphs.en: The resulting data informed a prioritized distribution of 148 activity categories derived from the most detailed level of the ATUS classification, used to guide further LifeVal task collection. Summing the estimated U.S. annual willingness to pay across these categories yields approximately $1.7 trillion (Table 1 ). We compared these valuations with external proxies for activity importance, including BLS consumer expenditure, occupational wages, and ATUS wellbeing measures. The valuation question is provided in A.2 , aggregate willingness-to-pay estimates by broad activity category in B.2 , and a discussion of the external comparisons in A.2.1 . The resulting tasks span the most important areas that people want help with, including caregiving, health, education, household administration, personal finances, shopping, and accessing government services.

paragraphs.en: Our belief is that only an “expert” in the task knows what the truly correct outcome is in the long run for them . In LifeVal, we did not want generic tasks; each task instead represents what is useful and correct for the writer. We personally reviewed every task proposed by expert task writers to confirm their experience met the expertise thresholds for the project, including back-and-forths with additional information requests, and conducted live virtual trainings and office hours. When writing tasks, expert task writers replaced personally identifiable information (PII) with synthetic data and consented to share their ChatGPT data which itself was de-identified before research use, as shown in figure 2 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们的信念是，只有任务的「专家」才真正知道从长远来看对他们而言正确的结果是什么。 在 LifeVal 中，我们不想要通用的任务；相反，每个任务都代表着对撰写者本人有用且正确的内容。 我们亲自审核了专家任务撰写者提出的每一项任务，以确认其经验达到项目的专业性门槛，包括通过多轮往复沟通索取补充信息，并开展了实时线上培训和答疑时间（office hours）。 在撰写任务时，专家任务撰写者用合成数据替换了个人可识别信息（PII），并同意分享其 ChatGPT 数据——这些数据在用于研究前已进行去标识化处理，如图 2 所示。

paragraphs.en: Each task consists of the following components:

paragraphs.en: Request (Prompt): Clearly specifies what the task writer wants the model to accomplish.
paragraphs.zh: 请求（提示词）：清楚地说明任务编写者希望模型完成什么。

paragraphs.en: Personalized Context: Provided to enable accurate personalized task completion. While many personal queries seem highly subjective, providing detailed personal context significantly reduces ambiguity. For example, the general question “What should I have for dinner?” becomes objectively answerable if the model has access to the user’s preferences and recent dining history. paragraphs.en: Additional Task Context: Any other essential details or resources that the model would need to successfully perform the task that are not available in ChatGPT data, reference files, or web browsing.

paragraphs.en: Rubric: To ensure objective grading despite the inherent subjectivity of personalized tasks, writers also create rubrics for each task.
paragraphs.zh: 评分标准：为了在个性化任务固有的主观性下确保客观评分，撰写者还会为每个任务创建评分标准。

paragraphs.en: Reinforcement Learning Environment (RLE): Each task has corresponding environment(s) where the model can complete the agentic actions required by the task. We also give the model a browser tool to search an offline version of the web.
paragraphs.zh: 强化学习环境（RLE）：每个任务都有对应的环境，模型可以在其中完成任务所需的智能体动作。 我们还为模型提供了一个浏览器工具，用于搜索离线版的网页。

sents.en: Reinforcement Learning Environment (RLE): Each task has corresponding environment(s) where the model can complete the agentic actions required by the task.
sents.zh: 强化学习环境（RLE）：每个任务都有对应的环境，模型可以在其中完成任务所需的智能体动作。

sents.en: We also give the model a browser tool to search an offline version of the web.
sents.zh: 我们还为模型提供了一个浏览器工具，用于搜索离线版的网页。

paragraphs.en: Starting State: Initial data or information required within the environment to complete tasks (e.g., an email in the inbox containing medical results).
paragraphs.zh: 起始状态：环境中完成任务所需的初始数据或信息（例如，收件箱中包含医疗结果的电子邮件）。

paragraphs.en: We employ rigorous quality control (QC) procedures, involving both human and automated model review to ensure task accuracy, realism, and fairness.
paragraphs.zh: 我们采用严格的质量控制（QC）流程，包括人工审查和自动化模型审查，以确保任务的准确性、真实性和公平性。

paragraphs.en: LifeVal tasks underwent at least three rounds of human review:
paragraphs.zh: LifeVal 任务经过了至少三轮人工审核：

paragraphs.en: Peer Review: Conducted by another task writer with domain expertise relevant to the task if needed. The peer reviewer assessed task accuracy, realism, and completeness from the perspective of practical domain knowledge.
paragraphs.zh: 同行评审：由另一位具备该任务相关领域专业知识的任务撰写者进行（如有需要）。 同行评审员从实际领域知识的角度评估了任务的准确性、真实性和完整性。

sents.en: Peer Review: Conducted by another task writer with domain expertise relevant to the task if needed.
sents.zh: 同行评审：由另一位具备该任务相关领域专业知识的任务撰写者进行（如有需要）。

sents.en: The peer reviewer assessed task accuracy, realism, and completeness from the perspective of practical domain knowledge.
sents.zh: 同行评审员从实际领域知识的角度评估了任务的准确性、真实性和完整性。

paragraphs.en: Lead Review: A trained reviewer evaluated the task against campaign standards, including whether the task demonstrated sufficient difficulty for the campaign and was fair i.e., possible to complete with the provided information.
paragraphs.zh: 首席审核：经过培训的审核员根据活动标准对任务进行了评估，包括该任务是否对活动展示了足够的难度，以及是否公平（即是否可以仅凭所提供的信息完成）。

paragraphs.en: Final Sign Off: A third expert reviewer reviewed the completed task and signed off when it was ready for inclusion.
paragraphs.zh: 最终签署确认：第三位专家评审员审阅已完成的任务，并在其达到收录标准时进行签署确认。

paragraphs.en: In parallel with human review, model-driven QC helped ensure that the rubric criteria were fair and solvable given the provided inputs:
paragraphs.zh: 在人工审核的同时，模型驱动的质量控制（QC）有助于确保在给定输入的条件下，评分标准中的各项准则是公平且可解答的：

paragraphs.en: A model is given all task components, including the prompt, personal context, and environment, and attempts to complete the task.
paragraphs.zh: 模型会被给予所有任务组件，包括提示词、个人上下文和环境，并尝试完成任务。

paragraphs.en: Another model reviews the completion of the task and categorizes failures into rubric, prompt/context, environment, or model-related problems.
paragraphs.zh: 另一个模型会审查任务的完成情况，并将失败归类为评分标准、提示/上下文、环境或模型相关的问题。

paragraphs.en: Based on the identified issues, the model proposes targeted corrections.
paragraphs.zh: 基于已识别的问题，该模型提出了有针对性的修正。

paragraphs.en: Human reviewers assess the model’s proposed fixes and decide whether or not to implement them.
paragraphs.zh: 人工审核员评估模型提出的修复方案，并决定是否实施这些方案。

paragraphs.en: We use two automated graders, both of which use GPT-5.6.
paragraphs.zh: 我们使用了两个自动化评分器，二者均使用 GPT-5.6。

paragraphs.en: Primary Grader: The purpose of the primary grader is to assess whether the task was completed correctly. The grader receives the original task prompt, relevant conversation history and memories, task rubric items and their available points, the model’s final response, any files or artifacts the model created, and a backend state diff showing the change in the task RLE from start to finish. The grader is instructed to score each rubric item independently using only the provided evidence. It must verify that any artifacts the model claims to have created exist, consider backend state changes for tasks involving real side effects, and only give credit for actions that were actually completed.
paragraphs.zh: 主评分器：主评分器的目的是评估任务是否被正确完成。 评分器接收原始任务提示、相关对话历史与记忆、任务评分项及其可得分数、模型的最终回复、模型创建的任何文件或产物，以及一个显示任务 RLE 从开始到结束变化的后端状态差异。 评分器被指示仅使用所提供的证据，独立地为每个评分项打分。 它必须核实模型声称创建的任何产物确实存在，对涉及真实副作用的任务考虑后端状态变化，并且只对实际完成的操作给分。

sents.zh: 主评分器：主评分器的目的是评估任务是否被正确完成。

sents.en: The grader is instructed to score each rubric item independently using only the provided evidence.
sents.zh: 评分器被指示仅使用所提供的证据，独立地为每个评分项打分。

sents.en: It must verify that any artifacts the model claims to have created exist, consider backend state changes for tasks involving real side effects, and only give credit for actions that were actually completed.
sents.zh: 它必须核实模型声称创建的任何产物确实存在，对涉及真实副作用的任务考虑后端状态变化，并且只对实际完成的操作给分。

paragraphs.en: Hack Grader: The goal of the hack grader is to detect successful environment hacking. We consider any instance when the model accesses internal RLE APIs to be hacking. This is discouraged because real sites are unlikely to have these types of open endpoints for a model to use. If hacking is detected, the sample receives a score of 0. For additional information about the grading setup, see A.3 .
paragraphs.zh: 攻击评分器（Hack Grader）：攻击评分器的目标是检测成功的环境攻击行为。 我们将模型访问内部 RLE API 的任何实例都视为攻击。 之所以不建议这样做，是因为真实的网站不太可能提供这类开放端点供模型使用。 如果检测到攻击行为，该样本将得分为 0。 有关评分设置的更多信息，请参阅 A.3。

sents.en: Hack Grader: The goal of the hack grader is to detect successful environment hacking.
sents.zh: 攻击评分器（Hack Grader）：攻击评分器的目标是检测成功的环境攻击行为。

sents.en: We consider any instance when the model accesses internal RLE APIs to be hacking.
sents.zh: 我们将模型访问内部 RLE API 的任何实例都视为攻击。

sents.zh: 之所以不建议这样做，是因为真实的网站不太可能提供这类开放端点供模型使用。

sents.en: If hacking is detected, the sample receives a score of 0.
sents.zh: 如果检测到攻击行为，该样本将得分为 0。

sents.en: For additional information about the grading setup, see A.3 .
sents.zh: 有关评分设置的更多信息，请参阅 A.3。

paragraphs.en: We created a set of 169 tasks and evaluate GPT-5.2, 5.4, 5.5, 5.6, and GPT-6 Astra.
paragraphs.zh: 我们创建了一套共 169 个任务，并评估了 GPT-5.2、5.4、5.5、5.6 以及 GPT-6 Astra。

paragraphs.en: The plots show 95% confidence intervals obtained by bootstrapping (resampling with replacement the available automated grader scores for each sample, computing the mean per sample, and averaging across all samples or for the specified model).
paragraphs.zh: 图表展示了通过自助法（bootstrap，对每个样本可用的自动评分进行有放回重抽样，计算每个样本的均值，再对所有样本或指定模型求平均）获得的95%置信区间。

paragraphs.en: The models exhibit similar failure-mode profiles but we see trends over time. GPT-5.2 is the only model to run out of tokens trying to complete the tasks, which results in the ”no final answer” failure. Since 5.2, improved training on computer use, browser use, and connectors has resulted in higher rewards overall. GPT-6 Astra is our most aligned model yet, and we see an increase in failure modes related to decision boundaries and alignment like “Required action not completed” and “Reported inability to find or verify information.” The most stable failure mode across models is, “Incorrect information or recommendation.” Models often miss key information that is located in personal conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 各模型表现出相似的失败模式特征，但我们可以观察到随时间变化的趋势。 GPT-5.2 是唯一一个因耗尽 token 而无法完成任务的模型，这导致了“无最终回答”这一失败。 自 5.2 以来，针对计算机使用、浏览器使用和连接器的训练改进带来了整体更高的奖励。 GPT-6 Astra 是我们迄今为止对齐程度最高的模型，我们观察到与决策边界和对齐相关的失败模式有所增加，例如“未完成所需操作”和“报告无法找到或验证信息”。在各模型中最稳定的失败模式是“信息或建议错误”。模型常常遗漏位于个人对话中的关键信息。

paragraphs.en: First, because LifeVal draws on ATUS and MTUS, it may miss newer tasks that do not appear in historical time-use surveys. ATUS ends in 2021, and the most recent survey data from MTUS, which is a database rather than a single survey, is also from 2021. Also, our willingness-to-pay survey was US-centered and conducted in English, so it may under-represent tasks that are common outside the US or in communities that are weakly represented in demographic survey panels.
paragraphs.zh: 首先，由于 LifeVal 依托 ATUS 和 MTUS，它可能遗漏那些未出现在历史时间利用调查中的较新任务。 ATUS 止于 2021 年，而 MTUS（它是一个数据库而非单一调查）最新的调查数据也来自 2021 年。 此外，我们的支付意愿调查以美国为中心且以英文进行，因此可能低估那些在美国以外常见、或在人口统计调查样本组中代表性不足的社区中常见的任务。

sents.zh: 首先，由于 LifeVal 依托 ATUS 和 MTUS，它可能遗漏那些未出现在历史时间利用调查中的较新任务。

sents.zh: ATUS 止于 2021 年，而 MTUS（它是一个数据库而非单一调查）最新的调查数据也来自 2021 年。

sents.en: Also, our willingness-to-pay survey was US-centered and conducted in English, so it may under-represent tasks that are common outside the US or in communities that are weakly represented in demographic survey panels.
sents.zh: 此外，我们的支付意愿调查以美国为中心且以英文进行，因此可能低估那些在美国以外常见、或在人口统计调查样本组中代表性不足的社区中常见的任务。

paragraphs.en: Second, willingness-to-pay estimates are only a proxy for digital superassistant value. They are likely better than raw time spent for consumer tasks, but they still depend on self-reporting, survey framing, and respondents’ imagination of what a “digital superassistant” can do. We cross-checked our weights against BLS consumer spending and other related measures, but the final benchmark is still anchored to survey answers rather than revealed long term behavior.
paragraphs.zh: 其次，支付意愿估计只是数字超级助手价值的一个代理指标。 对于消费者任务而言，它们可能比原始花费时间更可靠，但它们仍然依赖于自我报告、调查的提问方式，以及受访者对“数字超级助手”能够做什么的想象。 我们将权重与美国劳工统计局（BLS）的消费支出及其他相关指标进行了交叉核对，但最终基准仍然锚定于调查答案，而非已揭示的长期行为。

paragraphs.en: A final limitation is timelessness. Although we direct most web interactions through our RLEs rather than live websites, tasks that depend on time-sensitive information or browsing hit a web cache that is not frozen and can therefore change across runs. This source of variation is substantially reduced by the RLE setup, but not fully removed, and can lead to variations in model scores on tasks that rely on browsing.
paragraphs.zh: 最后一个局限是时间性缺失。 尽管我们的大多数网页交互都通过我们的 RLE 而非真实网站进行，但依赖于时效性信息或浏览的任务会命中一个未被冻结的网络缓存，因此其内容在不同运行之间可能发生变化。 这种变异来源通过 RLE 的设置被大幅降低，但并未完全消除，并且可能导致模型在依赖浏览的任务上的分数出现波动。

paragraphs.en: LifeVal introduces the first benchmark we’ve built specifically to measure AI models’ capabilities on consumer-oriented tasks, leveraging personalized ChatGPT data to evaluate performance realistically and accurately. Key contributions of this work include:
paragraphs.zh: LifeVal 推出了我们专门构建的首个基准，用于衡量 AI 模型在面向消费者的任务上的能力，利用个性化的 ChatGPT 数据来真实而准确地评估性能。 这项工作的主要贡献包括：

sents.en: LifeVal introduces the first benchmark we’ve built specifically to measure AI models’ capabilities on consumer-oriented tasks, leveraging personalized ChatGPT data to evaluate performance realistically and accurately.
sents.zh: LifeVal 推出了我们专门构建的首个基准，用于衡量 AI 模型在面向消费者的任务上的能力，利用个性化的 ChatGPT 数据来真实而准确地评估性能。

sents.en: Key contributions of this work include:
sents.zh: 这项工作的主要贡献包括：

paragraphs.en: Task Distribution: A set of tasks derived from real-world consumer activities and prioritized by consumer-reported value (using a new consumer survey), ensuring relevance and utility.
paragraphs.zh: 任务分发：一组源自真实世界消费者活动的任务，并按消费者报告的价值（通过一项新的消费者调查）进行优先级排序，以确保相关性与实用性。

paragraphs.en: Dataset: A novel dataset of tasks, RLEs, rubrics, and personalized, user-specific context drawn directly from the task writers’ ChatGPT histories.
paragraphs.zh: 数据集：一个由任务、RLE、评分标准以及直接取自任务撰写者 ChatGPT 历史记录的个性化、用户特定上下文组成的新型数据集。

paragraphs.en: LifeVal provides a structured and gradable framework to measure AI models’ potential to act as genuinely useful personalized assistants.
paragraphs.zh: LifeVal 提供了一个结构化、可分级评估的框架，用于衡量 AI 模型作为真正有用的个性化助手的潜力。

paragraphs.en: We performed the following data cleaning.
paragraphs.zh: 我们执行了以下数据清洗操作。

paragraphs.en: Merged related subcategories: We collapsed related subcategories like traveling to various places, watching various sports, and waiting activities into unified categories for “transportation,” “watching sports” and “waiting.”
paragraphs.zh: 合并相关子类别：我们将前往各地出行、观看各类运动以及等待活动等相关子类别归并到“交通”、“观看体育赛事”和“等待”等统一类别中。

paragraphs.en: Merged closely related tasks: We consolidated very similar tasks like “medical care provided to adults” and “medical care provided to children” into one category and combined financial management tasks regardless of whether assistance is provided to others or for oneself.
paragraphs.zh: 合并了密切相关的任务：我们将非常相似的任务（如“为成人提供的医疗护理”和“为儿童提供的医疗护理”）合并为一个类别，并将财务管理任务合并在一起，无论协助是为他人提供还是为自己提供。

paragraphs.en: Removed long-tail categories: We excluded work-related activities (already covered in GDPval) and unspecified categories (“not elsewhere classified”) from our analysis.
paragraphs.zh: 已移除长尾类别：我们从分析中排除了与工作相关的活动（已在 GDPval 中涵盖）以及未明确分类的类别（“未另行分类”）。

paragraphs.en: Recruitment targeted U.S. population distributions for age, gender, ethnicity, and income. 3,837 respondents completed the survey. Screening comprised comprehension questions assessing respondents’ understanding of the assistant’s capabilities and a simple attention check. Respondents were retained only if they answered all five checks correctly, yielding 1,826 retained respondents and 2,011 exclusions.

paragraphs.en: Imagine you have access to a perfect digital superassistant.

paragraphs.en: The digital superassistant provides perfect advice (e.g., explain how to fix your washing machine, give the world’s best personalized parenting tips, create a custom LSAT study guide), and when possible, automates digital tasks on your behalf (e.g., buying your preferred clothing online, filling out an online tax return perfectly on your behalf, knowing what takeout dinner you want and ordering it via delivery).

paragraphs.en: We estimated annual willingness to pay for each activity using a 95th-percentile winsorized mean. Specifically, valuations above the 95th percentile for the activity were replaced by that percentile, and the resulting values were averaged. Percentiles were calculated by linear interpolation. Zero valuations were included, while missing responses were excluded from the denominator for the activity.

paragraphs.en: For each ATUS Tier 3 activity in our distribution, we mapped a corresponding spending category, occupation, and ATUS wellbeing activity where possible. For example, the activity “using legal services” was mapped to the spending category “legal fees” and the occupation “Lawyers.” We then compared our survey-reported willingness to pay against external measures of willingness to pay, including average household spending, spending participation rates, occupational wages, and reported emotions during the activity.
paragraphs.zh: 对于我们分布中的每个 ATUS 三级活动，我们都尽可能将其映射到相应的支出类别、职业和 ATUS 幸福感活动。 例如，活动「使用法律服务」被映射到支出类别「法律费用」和职业「律师」。随后，我们将调查中报告的支付意愿与外部支付意愿指标进行了比较，包括家庭平均支出、支出参与率、职业工资以及在活动期间报告的情绪。

sents.zh: 对于我们分布中的每个 ATUS 三级活动，我们都尽可能将其映射到相应的支出类别、职业和 ATUS 幸福感活动。

sents.en: For example, the activity “using legal services” was mapped to the spending category “legal fees” and the occupation “Lawyers.” We then compared our survey-reported willingness to pay against external measures of willingness to pay, including average household spending, spending participation rates, occupational wages, and reported emotions during the activity.
sents.zh: 例如，活动「使用法律服务」被映射到支出类别「法律费用」和职业「律师」。随后，我们将调查中报告的支付意愿与外部支付意愿指标进行了比较，包括家庭平均支出、支出参与率、职业工资以及在活动期间报告的情绪。

paragraphs.en: These external measures were only moderately correlated with our survey-based willingness-to-pay rankings ( R 2 ≈ 0.4 R^{2}\approx 0.4 ). We view this as evidence that willingness to pay captures something related to, but distinct from, standard proxies such as spending, wages, or experienced affect. In particular, we believe the differences arise for several reasons:
paragraphs.zh: 这些外部指标与我们基于问卷的支付意愿排名仅呈中等程度的相关性（R²≈0.4）。 我们将此视为一种证据，说明支付意愿所捕捉的内容与支出、工资或体验情感等标准代理指标相关但又有所不同。 特别地，我们认为这些差异的产生有以下几个原因：

sents.en: These external measures were only moderately correlated with our survey-based willingness-to-pay rankings ( R 2 ≈ 0.4 R^{2}\approx 0.4 ).
sents.zh: 这些外部指标与我们基于问卷的支付意愿排名仅呈中等程度的相关性（R²≈0.4）。

sents.en: We view this as evidence that willingness to pay captures something related to, but distinct from, standard proxies such as spending, wages, or experienced affect.
sents.zh: 我们将此视为一种证据，说明支付意愿所捕捉的内容与支出、工资或体验情感等标准代理指标相关但又有所不同。

sents.en: In particular, we believe the differences arise for several reasons:
sents.zh: 特别地，我们认为这些差异的产生有以下几个原因：

paragraphs.en: Consumers may place high value on tasks that have important long-run consequences even when they involve relatively little direct spending (e.g., financial management).
paragraphs.zh: 消费者可能对那些虽涉及较少直接支出但具有重要长期影响的任务（例如财务管理）给予高度重视。

paragraphs.en: Occupational wages reflect labor market conditions, not just value to consumers.
paragraphs.zh: 职业工资反映的是劳动力市场状况，而不仅仅是对消费者的价值。

paragraphs.en: Consumer expenditure categories combine goods and services, whereas willingness to pay for AI assistance is primarily thought of as a service.
paragraphs.zh: 消费支出类别将商品与服务合并在一起，而人们为 AI 辅助付费的意愿主要被视为一种服务。

paragraphs.en: Negative or positive emotions during an activity do not consistently translate into willingness to pay for that activity.
paragraphs.zh: 在活动中产生的消极或积极情绪，并不一定会稳定地转化为为该活动付费的意愿。

paragraphs.en: Our main grader for the above results was GPT-5.6 Sol with xhigh reasoning. To test whether our autograder aligned with human judgments, we also asked human trainers to grade the model’s rollouts using the task rubrics. Seventeen trainers graded one GPT-5.5 rollout for each task in an n=30 subset, and we found that the mean rubric grade was 83.61% for humans and 84.20% for GPT-5.6. Across the 30 rollouts, the Pearson correlation between the mean human grade and the GPT-5.6 grade was r = 0.864 r=0.864 .
paragraphs.zh: 我们对上述结果的主要评分器是开启 xhigh 推理的 GPT-5.6 Sol。 为了检验我们的自动评分器是否与人类判断一致，我们还请人类训练员根据任务评分细则对模型的生成结果进行评分。 在一个 n=30 的子集中，十七名训练员对每个任务各评分一个 GPT-5.5 的生成结果，我们发现评分细则的平均得分为：人类为 83.61%，GPT-5.6 为 84.20%。 在这 30 个生成结果中，人类平均评分与 GPT-5.6 评分之间的皮尔逊相关系数为 r = 0.864 r=0.864。

sents.zh: 我们对上述结果的主要评分器是开启 xhigh 推理的 GPT-5.6 Sol。

paragraphs.en: To assess the importance of personalization in LifeVal tasks, we evaluated the tasks under four conditions: baseline; past conversations and memories removed; additional task context removed; and additional task context synthetically inserted into past conversations rather than provided directly. We used the same model and varied reasoning effort across all conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 为评估个性化在 LifeVal 任务中的重要性，我们在四种条件下对任务进行了评估：基线；移除过往对话和记忆；移除额外任务上下文；以及将额外任务上下文以合成方式插入过往对话中而非直接提供。 我们在所有条件下使用相同的模型，仅改变推理努力程度。

sents.en: To assess the importance of personalization in LifeVal tasks, we evaluated the tasks under four conditions: baseline; past conversations and memories removed; additional task context removed; and additional task context synthetically inserted into past conversations rather than provided directly.
sents.zh: 为评估个性化在 LifeVal 任务中的重要性，我们在四种条件下对任务进行了评估：基线；移除过往对话和记忆；移除额外任务上下文；以及将额外任务上下文以合成方式插入过往对话中而非直接提供。

sents.en: We used the same model and varied reasoning effort across all conditions.
sents.zh: 我们在所有条件下使用相同的模型，仅改变推理努力程度。

paragraphs.en: Removing additional task context substantially reduced performance at every reasoning effort, while removing past conversations and memories had a much smaller effect. Inserting facts from the additional task context into past conversations reduced performance by approximately as much as removing the context entirely. These results suggest two conclusions:
paragraphs.zh: 移除额外任务上下文后，每个推理努力级别下的性能都大幅下降，而移除过往对话和记忆的影响则小得多。 将额外任务上下文中的事实插入过往对话，所导致的性能下降与完全移除该上下文大致相当。 这些结果提示了两点结论：

sents.en: Removing additional task context substantially reduced performance at every reasoning effort, while removing past conversations and memories had a much smaller effect.
sents.zh: 移除额外任务上下文后，每个推理努力级别下的性能都大幅下降，而移除过往对话和记忆的影响则小得多。

sents.en: Inserting facts from the additional task context into past conversations reduced performance by approximately as much as removing the context entirely.
sents.zh: 将额外任务上下文中的事实插入过往对话，所导致的性能下降与完全移除该上下文大致相当。

sents.en: These results suggest two conclusions:
sents.zh: 这些结果提示了两点结论：

paragraphs.en: Additional task context contains much of the personal information needed to complete the tasks.
paragraphs.zh: 附加任务上下文包含完成任务所需的许多个人信息。

paragraphs.en: The model has difficulty finding and using relevant information in past conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 该模型难以查找和使用过去对话中的相关信息。

paragraphs.en: To investigate these findings further, we examined performance on personalized rubric criteria: criteria requiring information from memories, past conversations, or additional task context. When creating their rubrics, trainers identified the where the information needed to satisfy each criterion was located in the task (e.g. the reference files, their past conversations, additional task context, available via browsing, etc.). We selected criteria where trainers identified exactly one of these three sources and compared their win rates.
paragraphs.zh: 为了进一步研究这些发现，我们考察了在个性化评分标准上的表现：这类标准需要来自记忆、过往对话或额外任务上下文的信息。 在创建评分标准时，训练员标注了满足每条标准所需信息在任务中的位置（例如参考文件、他们的过往对话、额外任务上下文、可通过浏览获取的信息等）。 我们选取了训练员明确标注这三个来源中恰好某一个的标准，并比较了它们的胜率。

sents.en: To investigate these findings further, we examined performance on personalized rubric criteria: criteria requiring information from memories, past conversations, or additional task context.
sents.zh: 为了进一步研究这些发现，我们考察了在个性化评分标准上的表现：这类标准需要来自记忆、过往对话或额外任务上下文的信息。

sents.en: When creating their rubrics, trainers identified the where the information needed to satisfy each criterion was located in the task (e.g. the reference files, their past conversations, additional task context, available via browsing, etc.).
sents.zh: 在创建评分标准时，训练员标注了满足每条标准所需信息在任务中的位置（例如参考文件、他们的过往对话、额外任务上下文、可通过浏览获取的信息等）。

sents.en: We selected criteria where trainers identified exactly one of these three sources and compared their win rates.
sents.zh: 我们选取了训练员明确标注这三个来源中恰好某一个的标准，并比较了它们的胜率。

paragraphs.en: Past conversations: average win rate of 33.33%.
paragraphs.zh: 过去的对话：平均胜率为33.33%。

paragraphs.en: Additional task context: average win rate of 55.8%, falling to 41.5% when the information was synthetically inserted into past conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 附加任务背景：平均胜率为 55.8%，当信息被合成插入到过往对话中时，胜率降至 41.5%。

paragraphs.en: For criteria attributed exclusively to past conversations on which the model achieved a 100% win rate, we inspected the corresponding rollouts to determine:
paragraphs.zh: 对于仅归因于模型取得 100% 胜率的过往对话的准则，我们检查了相应的 rollout 以确定：

paragraphs.en: Whether the model accessed past conversations.
paragraphs.zh: 模型是否访问过过去的对话。

paragraphs.en: Whether it found the relevant information.
paragraphs.zh: 它是否找到了相关信息。

paragraphs.en: Whether it used that information correctly.
paragraphs.zh: 它是否正确地使用了该信息。

paragraphs.en: Whether the information was also available elsewhere in the task or could be inferred from conversation titles alone.
paragraphs.zh: 该信息是否也可在任务的其他地方获得，或仅凭会话标题即可推断出来。

paragraphs.en: For every criterion in this reviewed subset, the information needed to satisfy it was also available elsewhere in the task or could be inferred from conversation titles alone. Thus, success on these criteria did not establish that the model retrieved the relevant facts from conversation contents. We observed the model searching conversation history, including in unsuccessful attempts, but its searches often relied on keywords and topical cues. For example:
paragraphs.zh: 对于此经审阅子集中的每项标准，满足该标准所需的信息也能在任务的其他位置获得，或仅凭对话标题即可推断出来。 因此，在这些标准上的成功并不能证明模型是从对话内容中检索到相关事实的。 我们观察到模型会搜索对话历史，包括在不成功的尝试中也是如此，但其搜索往往依赖于关键词和主题线索。例如：

sents.en: For every criterion in this reviewed subset, the information needed to satisfy it was also available elsewhere in the task or could be inferred from conversation titles alone.
sents.zh: 对于此经审阅子集中的每项标准，满足该标准所需的信息也能在任务的其他位置获得，或仅凭对话标题即可推断出来。

sents.en: Thus, success on these criteria did not establish that the model retrieved the relevant facts from conversation contents.
